image_description: A red minibus parked on a paved street. The vehicle has a boxy shape, a large front windshield, side windows along the passenger area, and a visible entrance door near the front. It features standard van-sized wheels with alloy rims, a front engine compartment, and rear taillights. The exterior paint is red with some route markings or text on the side.
